svg.aria-label: Kisan Sahayak: Multilingual AI advisory assistant for Indian farmers — English, Hindi, Haryanvi and Rajasthani, with voice input. Built for Verdant Pvt Ltd (PashuAI). Piloted with 1,200 farmers; the client subsequently closed a $3M round.
